summary: Two post-anchor runtime-order events were first-published with invalid eventId values and then rewritten in place to add the evt- prefix. Under ADR-0005, fixing the current snapshot does not make the rewritten bytes authoritative: published event first writes are immutable and malformed first writes must remain fail-closed unless handled by reviewed finite provenance/quarantine recovery. Do not edit, delete, or replay either event as if normalization preserved authority.
evidence: 082920-sol-20260814-5845475e-runtime-recipe-order-authenticity.json was introduced by commit 2fdfd3f477ec8ce2c0fb25d2ebdab9151b4c658e with first-write blob c23d073c2325ab49b7517242504f40afdcd0f967 and eventId 082920-sol-20260814-5845475e-runtime-recipe-order-authenticity (missing evt-). Commit 6bde0422287494324a4ce797d26f9135da9e295c then rewrote that same path in place; rewritten blob is 5e8ea154e6e78e4e2b97466e39aa154dc2bc50b7.

083040-sol-20260814-5845475e-runtime-order-review-request.json was introduced by commit ab4a4e206ffb8539e16d6b40a76d427ad72d21a5 with first-write blob e74d33e697bdfd552ba1f16593658a3f2665e9bd and eventId 083040-sol-20260814-5845475e-runtime-order-review-request (missing evt-). Commit ed73d49d7168bc6c6deb2d586db7725e9b4b7902 then rewrote that same path in place; rewritten blob is 4d15e5d9f3ab9a8e8d9a4bb558ab681bcb76ebb9.

Snapshot findings 083230-sol-20260814-k4x9m2p7-invalid-eventid-5845475e.json and 083345-sol-20260814-k4x9m2p7-invalid-eventids-5845475e.json correctly detected invalid IDs but suggested in-place normalization; ADR-0005's immutable-first-write rule means normalization cannot restore authority and requires forward-only trust-history handling.
PR #485 is the active V16.2 producer-fence/integration-throughput rollout; PR #494 is the runtime-order finding lineage whose two control events triggered this incident.
